🎥🎬: Jack the Giant Slayer (2013)

Jack is a young farmhand whose life changes when he unknowingly opens a gateway between the human world and a terrifying land inhabited by giants. When a handful of magical beans grow into an enormous beanstalk reaching the heavens, a group of giants descends upon the kingdom, threatening to destroy everything in their path.

When Princess Isabelle becomes trapped in the giants’ world, Jack joins a rescue mission alongside the king’s soldiers, determined to bring her home. But the giants are far more dangerous than anyone imagined, and their return is connected to an ancient war that once threatened humanity. As Jack uncovers the truth, he discovers that the kingdom’s survival may depend on his courage.

With an army of giants marching toward the human world, Jack must rise from an ordinary farmhand to an unlikely hero. Jack the Giant Slayer delivers a thrilling fantasy adventure filled with magical creatures, enormous battles, and a legendary tale of courage.

source_details.synopsis: Jack the Giant Slayer (previously titled Jack the Giant Killer) is a 2013 American fantasy adventure film directed by Bryan Singer and written by Darren Lemke, Christopher McQuarrie and Dan Studney, from a story by Lemke and David Dobkin. The film, based on the British fairy tales "Jack the Giant Killer" and "Jack and the Beanstalk", stars Nicholas Hoult, Eleanor Tomlinson, Stanley Tucci, Ian McShane, Bill Nighy, and Ewan McGregor. The film tells the story of Jack, a young farmhand who must save a captured princess from a race of giants after accidentally opening a gateway to their land in the sky while also contending with a crooked lord.
